## Goal
- Publish and verify the IVX owner-chat local-first AI dispatch repair and the Metro-before-Maestro CI repair, with owner-controlled source/deployment evidence.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use GitHub repository `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` on `main`.
- Do not hide failures with `@ts-ignore`, broad `any`, disabled checks, `continue-on-error`, or `|| true`.
- Preserve frozen lockfile enforcement and Bun `1.3.9`.
- Do not expose credentials, tokens, owner sessions, or production data.
- Avoid committing `.rork/history/main/` and generated report artifacts.
- Do not claim deployment or QA certification without SHA-matched live and CI evidence.
- Do not modify members, investors, payments, properties, credentials, production data, or owner permissions.
- User requires end-to-end deployment proof and 100% owner control rather than Rork-controlled access.

## Progress
### Done
- Diagnosed and repaired the local-first chat ordering defect:
  - Optimistic user row reached `USER_ROW_INSERTED`, but local-first `send_and_ai` awaited `sendQueue.mutateAsync(...)` before AI dispatch.
  - Added `expo/src/modules/chat/services/ivxSendTriggerPolicy.ts`.
  - Added `expo/__tests__/ivx-send-trigger-policy.test.ts`.
  - Updated `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx` to execute AI immediately for local-first `send_and_ai` and `ai_only`, while durable persistence retries independently.
  - Preserved persistence-first behavior for `send_only`, `attachment`, and remote-first traffic.
  - Preserved elevated-confirmation handling before assistant execution.
- Diagnosed Maestro launch failure in GitHub Actions run `30728658851`:
  - TypeScript, lint, and Playwright succeeded.
  - Maestro failed at `expo/.maestro/ivx-app-launch.yaml` with `Assertion is false: "IVX" is visible`.
  - Root cause: `bunx expo run:ios --configuration debug --no-bundler` launched the dev client without a Metro server.
- Added Metro startup logic to `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml`:
  - Starts `bunx expo start --dev-client --non-interactive --port 8081`.
  - Polls `http://127.0.0.1:8081/status` for `packager-status:running`.
  - Only then runs `bunx expo run:ios --configuration debug --no-bundler`.
- Reinstalled Expo dependencies successfully:
  - `cd expo && bun install --frozen-lockfile`
  - Installed 1332 packages with Bun `1.3.9`.
- Local validation after dependency installation:
  - `cd expo && bun test __tests__/ivx-send-trigger-policy.test.ts __tests__/ivx-owner-ai-orchestrator.test.ts __tests__/ivx-watchdog.test.ts` passed.
  - `cd expo && bunx tsc --noEmit --pretty false` passed.
  - `cd expo && bun run lint` passed with existing warnings only.

### In Progress
- Determine which repair changes survived the latest Rork workspace synchronization and create a clean publishable commit.
- Obtain authenticated owner-controlled GitHub and Render access or transfer the configured remotes/deployment credentials to the owner-controlled accounts.
- Publish the clean release, monitor CI, deploy, and verify production SHA parity.

### Blocked
- No `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `RENDER_API_KEY`, or `RENDER_SERVICE_ID` is available in the current tool environment:
  - `GITHUB_TOKEN_LEN=0 RENDER_API_KEY_LEN=0`
  - GitHub API request returned HTTP `401`.
  - Render API deployment query returned HTTP `400`.
- The configured `origin` is Rork-managed, not the requested direct GitHub repository remote:
  - `https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu`
- Current local branch is not synchronized with the configured Rork remote:
  - Local `HEAD`: `966210e60a840c757dcadaf84272fdb5e39211d5` (`New version from Rork`)
  - `origin/main`: `1c09e5b1` (`Improved the chat experience and fixed errors in the automated check system.`)
  - Local `main` is `ahead 1`.
- Production remains on the older commit and cannot be truthfully marked as containing the current repairs:
  - `https://api.ivxholding.com/health` reports commit `d1d232a65328a4a045644d838b5014a1c74e0ef7`.
- Uncommitted `.rork/history/main/` files exist and must not be published.

## Key Decisions
- Repair the proven ordering defect at the stalled checkpoint rather than changing unrelated owner execution or production behavior.
- For local-first AI modes, dispatch from the visible optimistic row and persist independently through the retry queue.
- Keep remote-first and non-AI sends persistence-first.
- Use a pure policy helper plus unit tests to enforce persistence/AI ordering without mounting `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx`.
- Repair the actual Maestro failure by starting Metro before launching a dev-client build, rather than weakening or removing the launch assertion.
- Require direct owner credentials/remotes, CI success, and production SHA parity before declaring owner-controlled deployment complete.
- Do not treat Rork workspace synchronization as proof of GitHub ownership or production deployment.

## Next Steps
1. Run `git status --short`, `git diff --check`, and inspect `git show --name-only HEAD` to identify the current clean repair set after Rork synchronization.
2. Ensure `.rork/history/main/` modifications remain excluded from every commit.
3. Verify `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml` still contains the Metro readiness step and the local-first policy files remain present.
4. Configure a direct owner-controlled GitHub remote for `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` and authenticate with an owner GitHub token or SSH key.
5. Configure owner-controlled Render API credentials/service access for `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`, or enable Render auto-deploy from the owner GitHub repository.
6. Commit and push only the intended chat and CI repair files to GitHub `main`.
7. Monitor the new GitHub Actions run; require TypeScript, lint, Playwright, and Maestro success.
8. Verify Render deploy completion and require GitHub `main` SHA = Render deployment SHA = `https://api.ivxholding.com/health` commit.
9. Verify the local-first Expo/Rork runtime reaches `AI_TRIGGER_DECISION` and `AI_MUTATION_STARTED` without watchdog timeout.

## Critical Context
- Prior production SHA:
  - `d1d232a65328a4a045644d838b5014a1c74e0ef7`
  - `/health`: `status: "healthy"`, `environment: "production"`, `bootTime: "2026-08-02T02:52:25.383Z"`, `version: "ivx-owner-ai-backend-v2026.07.26"`.
- Current workspace source-control state observed after synchronization:
  - `HEAD`: `966210e60a840c757dcadaf84272fdb5e39211d5`
  - `origin/main`: `1c09e5b1`
  - `git remote -v` points only to Rork router URL, not `github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform.git`.
- Current uncommitted files observed:
  - `.rork/history/main/00msb6m5ta001_1b8k289ymw7t8ht0e50nd_assistant.json`
  - `.rork/history/main/00msb75g3y001_hpyh99yrkptf7r5jeqbdo_assistant.json`
  - `.rork/history/main/00msb7vn40001_4flfneq4g8d69i7kkndmv_assistant.json`
- Initial validation failures before `bun install --frozen-lockfile` were dependency-environment failures, not repair failures:
  - `Cannot find module '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage'`
  - `Cannot find module 'eslint'`
  - Numerous TypeScript module-resolution errors.
  - All focused tests, typecheck, and lint completed successfully after installation.
- Local-first mode is enabled only if `EXPO_PUBLIC_IVX_CHAT_BACKEND_MODE` is `local`, `local_first`, or `offline`; default is `remote_first`.
- `shouldStartAssistantBeforePersistence` returns true only for:
  - `{ localFirstChatMode: true, mode: 'send_and_ai' }`
  - `{ localFirstChatMode: true, mode: 'ai_only' }`
- Relevant watchdog checkpoint order:
  - `SEND_TAP`
  - `USER_ROW_INSERTED`
  - `AI_TRIGGER_DECISION`
  - `AI_MUTATION_STARTED`
  - `BACKEND_POST_STARTED`
  - `BACKEND_POST_FINISHED`
  - Assistant-render checkpoints.
- Failed Maestro evidence:
  - Run ID: `30728658851`
  - Job ID: `91444971768`
  - Artifact ID: `8827635725`
  - Failure: `Assertion is false: "IVX" is visible`.
- `expo/.maestro/ivx-chat-qa-full.yaml` has separate unsupported `scroll.direction` syntax if that full flow is enabled.

## Relevant Files
- `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx`: owner-chat send flow; dispatches local-first AI before durable persistence settles.
- `expo/src/modules/chat/services/ivxSendTriggerPolicy.ts`: pure local-first assistant-start policy.
- `expo/__tests__/ivx-send-trigger-policy.test.ts`: policy regression coverage.
- `expo/src/modules/chat/services/useChatSendQueue.ts`: hook around durable chat persistence.
- `expo/src/modules/chat/services/chatTransportQueue.ts`: retrying persistence queue whose wait caused AI-dispatch delay.
- `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxLocalFirstRuntime.ts`: determines local-first versus remote-first runtime mode.
- `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxAIWatchdog.ts`: watchdog checkpoints and timeout diagnostics.
- `expo/__tests__/ivx-owner-ai-orchestrator.test.ts`: assistant lifecycle tests.
- `expo/__tests__/ivx-watchdog.test.ts`: watchdog tests.
- `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml`: Metro startup/readiness repair before `expo run:ios --no-bundler`.
- `expo/.maestro/ivx-app-launch.yaml`: Maestro smoke flow failing at `assertVisible: "IVX"`.
- `expo/.maestro/ivx-chat-qa-full.yaml`: full chat flow with separate unsupported `scroll.direction` syntax.
- `render.yaml`: production Render configuration; service `ivx-holdings-platform`, branch `main`, auto-deploy trigger `commit`, domain `api.ivxholding.com`.
- `backend/services/operational-memory/operational-adapters.ts`: Render status/deploy API adapter requiring `RENDER_API_KEY` and `RENDER_SERVICE_ID`.
- `docs/AI_PATH_OWNERSHIP_HANDOFF.md`: owner AI configuration and handoff reference.
- `.rork/history/main/`: generated Rork conversation history; do not commit.
